title: node -r tsconfig-paths/register runs mocha's CLI: the hook resolves the moved alias to legacy/util/x.js, while tsc resolves it to the moved file

expectedChecks.reason: under node/emit+tsconfig-paths (the hook reads tsconfig.json: @/* -> legacy/*, src/*), '@/util/x' resolves to legacy/util/x.js, expected src/util/x.ts

notes: runner vitest links this repo's node_modules, which holds tsconfig-paths 4, the hook the test script preloads (mocha itself is not installed, so K3b and K6 skip). Round 2 dropped every node launch of a test runner's CLI as K3b's; K3b applied no node-level hook and didn't see _mocha as mocha, so K3c fell back to its hook-less assumed runtime and the alias compared unresolved == unresolved.

origin.before: built by hand from the review's evidence (its scratch repro, /tmp/s7-reverify-k3cmocha)
origin.after: the move src/lib/x.ts -> src/util/x.ts with the alias rewritten, as the executor writes it
